findings.reason: without naming the shared readiness read and the promotion-time caller, a node can guard only the admission pass, pass its gate, and leave the production release path running before the merge.
findings.text: §40's deliverable is a release that happens only once the upstream's head is on the primary branch, but the release route it does not name fires earlier: `complete()` calls `_release_waiters_of_the_landed_section` (`reckon/crew/promotion.py:775`) inside the promotion, and `--land` merges only "after the promotion" (`reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3156`), so a coordinator declaring the section done and landing its run releases the waiters at the declaration commit — the exact incident §40 reports — while the section's own done-when, driving the admission pass, stays green; the fix is to name the shared readiness read that both `admit_once` and `_release_waiters` (`reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3916`) consult as the enforcement point and to add a case releasing through the promotion route

findings.reason: adding s40 to §14's declared waits is one line and prevents the whole-plan drain from running on an unlanded admission path, the failure the earlier waits on s35–s38 were added to avoid.
findings.text: §14 is `implementable`, declares no wait on `s40`, and its text says the drain starts "Once every other section has landed", while s40 rewrites `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py`, the admission pass the drain runs on; the same wait was added for s35, s36, s37 and s38, so a queue that admits §14 can launch it alongside §40 onto that module

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `e0b2a6abb` resolves in power_convertor as "docs(plans): mark ripple-inception section 2 done", `a10d921b2` resolves there, the cited plan `ripple-inception-risk` carries §2 and §4, and `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py` exists.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §40's done-when is measurable (a waiter held while the promoted section head is off the primary branch, released on the pass after the merge) and declares a negative control that releases on the declaration alone, which fails the first case.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every log is named under the run directory, a durable path that outlives the run.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §40's file name and terminology are mechanism-named, with no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §40 states its guarantee over "a queued request that waits on a section is released only when…", but names only the admission pass and scopes the change to `queue_admission.py`; the promotion route already releases those waiters before the merge (`reckon/crew/promotion.py:775`), and the done-when exercises only the admission pass.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §40 carries one deliverable: a section wait releases only when the section's runs have landed, with the hand-completed no-run case named as the deliberate exception.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — `plan-section-depends-on` (line 22) gives `s14` waits through `s38` but not `s40`, while §14's first sentence says the drain begins once every other section has landed and §40 rewrites `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py`, the module §14's admission pass runs on.
